_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY, AND INERT BY CONSTRUCTION. The harness loads settings.json and
settings.local.json; it never loads this file. That is the point: .gitignore records that
anything tracked under .claude/ must carry `.example.` in its name, so a tracked control can
never look installed when it is not.
TO USE IT: copy the blocks you want into your own settings, and replace every
REPLACE_WITH_ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO_YOUR_CHECKOUT with a real absolute path. The placeholder is loud
on purpose -- a hook with a wrong path fails silently, and a silent hook is indistinguishable
from a hook that decided to allow.
These are the HAND-WIRED hooks. The gates that an installer writes -- the worktree gate, the
collision gate, the session banner, the announce hook -- are not here. docs/HOOKS.md has the
full event map and says which installer owns which.
